STATE OF NEVADA
                                               Dept. of Conservation & Natural Resources
                                                                 Joe Lombardo, Governor
                                                               Vinson Guthreau, Director
                                                          Jonathan Brunjes, Administrator



    NOTICE OF STAKEHOLDER MEETING TO REVIEW REGULATIONS OF THE NEVADA
            DIVISION OF STATE PARKS PER EXECUTIVE ORDER 2026-003


The Nevada Division of State Parks (NDSP) is organizing a stakeholder meeting to gather
recommendations on regulations that could be streamlined, clarified, amended, or
repealed. The meeting will also provide an opportunity for stakeholders to share feedback
on current regulations and identify areas where further improvements may be needed.


Date:            October 28, 2026
Time:            10:00am
Location:        Nevada Division of State Parks Headquarters, Richard Bryan Building
                 901 S. Stewart Street, Tahoe Conference Room (2nd Floor)
                 Carson City, NV 89701
Virtual:         https://teams.microsoft.com/meet/246293112573215?p=N8FCXZE0SmOrYDFwEG
Meeting ID:      246 293 112 573 215
Passcode:        Mv267Ga9
Or call in (audio only) +1 775-321-6111,, 272171094#


NDSP has regulatory authority over the following Nevada Administrative Code (NAC)
Chapter 407. Links to the current regulations are provided below. Please note that Chapter
407 has not yet been updated on the Legislative Counsel Bureau website to reflect
amendments approved in April 2024; however, the approved regulation is included here for
reference.
    •      Chapter 407 – State Parks and Monuments
    •      Approved regulation LCB File No. R123-23

Persons wishing to make verbal comment on the proposed regulation of the Division are
encouraged to participate in the scheduled workshop, either in person or via Microsoft
Teams. Persons wishing to submit written testimony or documentary evidence may
submit the material by emailing stparks@.nv.gov or by mailing to the following address:
Nevada Division of State Parks, 901 S. Stewart Street Ste. 5005, Carson City, NV 89701.

Reasonable efforts will be made for members of the public who have disabilities and
require special accommodations for assistance at the meeting. Please contact the
Division at 775-684-2770 or stparks@nv.gov prior to the meeting.
Notice of this meeting has been posted to the following locations: Division website at
https://parks.nv.gov/, Nevada Public Notice website at https://notice.nv.gov/, and physical
notice at 901 S. Stewart Street, Carson City, NV 89701.




                                              AGENDA
   1. CALL MEETING TO ORDER

   2. PUBLIC COMMENT
       All public comments should be as brief and concise as possible so that all who wish to speak may do
       so (3 minutes for individuals and 5 minutes for group representatives). Comment will not be
       restricted based on viewpoint.

   3. REVIEW OF REGULATIONS UNDER THE AUTHORITY OF THE DIVISION OF STATE
      PARKS
       *Public comment will be accepted during this item.*
       Pursuant to Executive Order 2026-003, the Division will solicit input on regulations under its
       authority, including Nevada Administrative Code (NAC) Chapters 407. Comments should
       pertain specifically to regulatory content. Feedback received will inform the Division’s
       comprehensive review of regulations subject to its authority.

   4. Public Comment
       All public comments should be as brief and concise as possible so that all who wish to speak may do
       so (3 minutes for individuals and 5 minutes for group representatives). Comment will not be
       restricted based on viewpoint.

   5. Adjourn
